gen-gf-bellota-gf-encode-sans-semi-conde: Bellota's s swings its ends far away from the spine, and every stroke is traced as if by one stylus. Encode Sans Semi Condensed brings a sans with open counters and a little more modulation, so it does the quiet, steady work.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-encode-sans-semi-expan: Bellota draws its strokes at one weight, with an s whose ends hang loose, over a plain sans with rounded, open letters. Encode Sans Semi Expanded keeps things level beneath it.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-exo: Distinctive is the right word for Bellota, whose s hangs its ends far from the spine and whose strokes have no hairlines or shadows. Exo follows with wide gaps that keep a sans crisp, so a long run of text goes down smoothly.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-exo-2: Exo 2 reads clean, its curves holding plenty of daylight inside. Bellota is best when its hairline-free, stylus-width strokes get to stand out, while Exo 2 is the one for plain sans text.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-fahkwang: Commanding, Bellota is, with a toothpaste-line stroke and an s that flings its ends wide. Fahkwang, a sans with faint nib pressure in its rounds, is the quieter partner, and Bellota earns its keep big and short.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-figtree: Figtree looks drawn with a marker tip, with an e that leaves a wide gap at its terminal. Bellota sits above in its stylus-traced strokes and wide-swinging s, so the sans below feels friendly beside it.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-finlandica: Finlandica gives e crossbars open mouths and an outline you could trace with a finger. Finlandica stays easy on a plain sans page, while Bellota's s with its far-hung ends adds a commanding tug up top.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-fustat: Fustat reads like bent rope or tubing, with a wide gap where the c ends, and it feels thoroughly modern. And Bellota, with its far-hung s and stylus-width strokes, sits next to that plain sans as a brisk, distinctive neighbor.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-gantari: Wire-bent and friendly, Gantari's sans letters carry wide c apertures through each word. And Bellota brings the pair's strongest quality, a stylus-traced stroke and a far-reaching s that makes the heading unmistakable.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-gayathri: Gayathri reads open-ended on every curve, with the mild thick-thin of a letterpress slug. And Bellota is best at an o with sides and top equally thick, while Gayathri does the gentle plain sans work.
